name: smwsprites-activate-bowser-scene
title: Activate Bowser Scene
description:
A disassembly of Bowser (sprite A0), commented and ready to be inserted with PIXI.

Please note that the level mode should be set to 10 and the sprite memory to 00 for the sprite to work correctly.

Check the ASM file for customization options, especially if you're using AddmusicK.
